prompts.basic: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fighting game whole-figure sprite sheet. Reference image: supplied Rain Code Yuma character/motion sheet, identity/design reference only. Create a high-quality clean anime cel shaded sheet of Yuma Kokohead ALONE, exactly preserving his small youthful 4-head-tall proportions, large violet eyes, short lavender-gray hair, large black detective hat with dark blue band, black short detective cloak, dark navy school detective uniform with gold buttons and boots. Keep full hat/hair/hands/cloak/boots and entire blue-violet solution blade/key in every cell. No Shinigami, no partner, no ghosts, no mannequin, no opponent. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no shadows/background/labels/letters/grid/borders. Exact 4 columns x4 rows, 16 isolated full figures, equally spaced generous transparent gutters. Consistent camera and constant body/head/limb dimensions across all16, do not individually scale to fill cells. Horizontal art mostly faces RIGHT unless specified. Fully finished limbs and crisp controlled linework, detailed eyes. Whole figures only, no joint rigs, no dismemberment. This is BASIC MOTION sheet. Row-major cells: 0 neutral upright relaxed standing facing right, arm relaxed, blade down beside body, full height clear; 1 walk step A; 2 walk step B; 3 run with cloak trailing left; 4 dash start low leaning right; 5 crouch knees bent; 6 jump takeoff legs springing; 7 ascending jump arms balanced; 8 second jump tucked knee; 9 airborne neutral fall; 10 landing knees bent; 11 turn toward left; 12 relaxed idle looking forward; 13 ready stance blade at side; 14 relaxed exhale; 15 neutral upright same scale as0. These are character motions with NO weapon glow or FX paint. Every figure occupies about 65% cell height, neutral boots share a flat bottom. Preserve authentic reference outfit and petite proportions.
